entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: West to northwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Note, winds are expected to ease in Wairarapa late Thursday morning, and in the Tararua District and Central Hawke's Bay during Thursday afternoon. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.
